properties.title: Are you tired of death and fear?

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D4AB02_1783226635
properties.title:
This is not a Crypter vault. Nothing useful to Axum is stored here. It will not save you or your spawn. 

It is a message for helpful aliens.

For hope's sake, do not destroy it. Soteria.

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_D8BBC154AD47F92502_1668860658
properties.title:
Do not attempt the tunnel to Habitat without a guide. I'm tired of hearing people stagger out of a biobed complaining that the swim was longer than they realized. 

-Mantis

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_NoAdaptation_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D3AB02_1367563446
properties.title: We call you Architects. We call ourselves Axum. This world is Proteus.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_NoAdaptation_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D3AB02_1560958447
properties.title: We beg your pardon. We called to you for help. We know it is your [delight?] to visit and study.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_NoAdaptation_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D3AB02_1716501448
properties.title: We believe this observatory will survive our drowning. We chose it to hold our message.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_NoAdaptation_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D3AB02_1948911449
properties.title: Open the observatory. Find the computer hidden inside. It will tell you what we ask.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_NoAdaptation_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D3AB02_2139463450
properties.title: "If you become weak, seek remedy in strangeness." Soteria.

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_047C16452563560E02_1128018508
properties.title:
Somewhere
under this silt
is the first place I died

I think -
I can't remember -
The company owns that memory.

-Nahema

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_D8BBC15DBD732F6F02_1942958003
properties.title:
In these tangled corridors, the first of us struggled to survive.

Maybe some of us were among them. We cannot remember.

Their sacrifices let us work towards a better future. A world that will be our home.

-Sophie

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_60CF846429E0D5AB02_1185122814
properties.title:
When we hear this place, we say
"Remember, we saw the stars. A credit to our species. Not like what came after."
But we are what came after. Leftovers: tailings.
When we tend this place with broken claws,
who will credit us? Against what debt?

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_D843AE5FA0B883C202_1403847690
properties.title:
Good mining here.

Set nets for human thieves.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_047C16452563C9C202_1406781177
properties.title: Long ago, fire users, called Ardhiacs, built a telescope at Karakorum to spy on the World Tree at Xanadu.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_047C16452563CAC202_1614011411
properties.title: After the zero year, when the Daughter fell from space, all Axum fled to deep water. The telescope was destroyed.

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_047C16452563CAC202_1832794433
properties.title: In the year 500 pi, brave magi and vepherds returned to Karakorum. They rebuilt this observatory to study the Erratic Messenger.

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_047C16452563A1B902_2028202866
properties.title:
STOP STEALING MY RESONATOR! If you want to clear bloom growth, fabricate your own!

-Wu

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_047C16452563A2B902_1552599116
properties.title:
Reminder: 1200 calories a day. Foraging won't help. The only safe food is food we grow in here.

-Wu

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_047C164525630A0E02_2055554254
properties.title: I wish it were different. I want this awful place torn apart and melted down for scrap. — Sophie

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_047C164525630A0E02_2109930255
properties.title: I hear you. Sometimes I'm glad I got reset and can't remember. — Zip

properties.name: BP_AxumGlyph_C_UAID_047C16452563C9C202_2009447216
properties.title: Today Karakorum burns methane to power Xanadu. New telescopes are better. This old tower stands as a museum.

properties.name: BP_BaseModule_HydroponicTank_01a_C_UAID_3C7C3FF5ADFD173102_1528752821
properties.title:
A bloom canker, open to feed. Resonators can destroy them in this state.

-Wu

properties.name: BP_BaseModule_HydroponicTank_01a_C_UAID_3C7C3FF5ADFD183102_1162697999
properties.title:
Small biofilms can be cut apart, but the big ones need a resonator.

-Wu

properties.name: BP_BaseModule_HydroponicTank_01a_C_UAID_D8BBC154AD47955202_1300946454
properties.title:
Cankers close when they're not hungry. The resonator can't break the shell.

-Wu

properties.title:
The NoA behind this door controls the Tadpole clamps. The door is locked by a kurultai-level passcode.

Between Masefield and the Jubilee situation, we can't risk any more rogue trips into the Protected Zone. Relations with the Segments are bad enough already.

If you want a Tadpole, you'll need medical clearance from me and someone from the kurultai to let you in.

-Sophie

properties.title:
I haven't found a way to actually eat the jelly yet, but the rings are STUFFED with heat shock proteins. I think this cave used to be a lot more active.

Has anyone else noticed it cooling down up top? I swear my fingers go numb back at Habitat now. Maybe I'm adapting.

-Zip

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_60CF846429E09F6102_1485063926
properties.title:
We left Habitat to find the Jubilee, to hear what Proteus is telling us. This old camp is only a waystation. A first step.

What lessons have we learned? — Anita

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_60CF846429E0A16102_1268089280
properties.title: Sisu is the key to all things. — Iso

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_60CF846429E0A16102_2077125286

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_60CF846429E0A26102_1120887463
properties.title: Flares will distract the big predators. — Singh

properties.title: Hey joobs, I'm hooking our hatches up to external buttons. It's just a simple backup in case the door automation goes down. We can't rely on systems Sophie still controls. — Thing One

properties.name: BP_ProximityTextPop_C_UAID_60CF846429E09E6102_1476561748
